item.title: Lenny and Luke see off Preston at Deepdale
item.description: Millwall were 2-0 winners against Preston North End at Deepdale on Saturday afternoon. Ryan Leonard scored his first Championship goal of the season - and a third in all competitions - in the first-half to give Alex Neil's side the lead, with Luke Cundle stepping off the bench to secure a third straight away win in second-half stoppage-time. item.title: Preston reaction from Alex Neil
item.description: Alex Neil expressed his pleasure following The Lions' 2-0 Sky Bet Championship win at Preston North End on Saturday afternoon. Ryan Leonard and Luke Cundle bagged the goals at Deepdale as Millwall secured a third straight away win, with the Head Coach's post-match reaction now available below.

item.title: Photos from Deepdale
item.description: Ryan Leonard and Luke Cundle scored the goals as Millwall beat Preston North End 2-0 at Deepdale on Saturday afternoon. Take a look at the best of the action from Lancashire in the gallery below.

item.title: Lenny the Lion speaks to Millwall TV+
item.description: A fantastic finish - and celebration - from Ryan Leonard! The right-back opened the scoring at Deepdale in Saturday's 2-0 Sky Bet Championship win over Preston North End, heading towards the away fans and celebrating in style. Below, Lenny talks through his goal and more, as well as explaining those dance moves!

item.title: Lovelace nets as Under 21s draw with Cardiff City
item.description: Millwall Under 21s picked up a point in League action on Tuesday afternoon in a home draw with Cardiff City.
